scripts.dev: docker compose up -d db && sh -c 'until docker compose exec -T db pg_isready -U repolens; do sleep 1; done' && npm run prisma:deploy && concurrently -n api,web,analyzer -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:analyzer"
scripts.dev:analyzer: cd services/analyzer && (test -d .venv || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001
scripts.test: npm run test -w @repolens/api && npm run test -w @repolens/web && cd services/analyzer && (.venv/bin/pytest -q || python3 -m pytest -q)
scripts.build: npm run build -w @repolens/api && npm run build -w @repolens/web
